# SheetSchema

<link-summary>What a sheet's columns are called and what they hold.</link-summary>

<web-summary>SheetSchema — What a sheet's columns are called and what they hold. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet/types</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
interface SheetSchema
```

`version` marks the format so a later one can be recognised rather than misread, `headerRow` says which row holds the names, and `columns` describes them left to right.

`getSchema` sets `inferred: true` when nothing was stored and the description was read off the sheet's own contents — a guess, not a declaration.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const schema = {
  version: 1,
  headerRow: 1,
  columns: [
    { name: "id", type: "number" },
    { name: "email", type: "string" }
  ]
};
```
